compatibleEngines.note: v1.2.0 adds apps/api/middleware.ts to the Template source. Engines 0.2.0+ recognize the new file and the schema-versioned Sync event log contract introduced in issue #30. Older engines cannot record apply/promotion events and would lose audit history, so they are excluded by the minimum.

migrations.description: Create the .beztack/migrations/v1.2.0-applied marker file so future sync runs can detect that this Derived project already accepted the v1.2.0 Environment contract.

dryRun.note: Prints 'already-applied' if the marker is present, 'pending' otherwise. Does not modify project state.

migrations.note: Marker-file migration. Safe and reversible (delete the file to 'unapply'). The engine surfaces it for review but does not run it.

migrations.description: Rotate the WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET environment variable and re-register the new value with the upstream payment provider. Requires interactive confirmation because the rotation invalidates in-flight webhook deliveries.

dryRun.note: Prints 'already-applied' if the rotation marker contains 'v1.2.0', 'pending' otherwise.

migrations.note: Interactive migration: forces 'manual' execution regardless of trust class. Engine surfaces this as a manual step in status and apply output.

migrations.description: Publish the v1.2.0 secrets bundle to the Trusted Derived project registry so Beztack-owned pipelines can pick it up automatically. Community Derived projects do not get this bundle and must vendor the secrets manually.

dryRun.note: Reports whether the secrets bundle is already registered for this Template version.

migrations.note: Trusted-only migration. Community Derived projects must not run this; the engine surfaces it as 'manual-execution-required' and notes the trust restriction.
